objective: Reassess the reference calibrated static mesh after the owner's symmetric +/-20% artist count rule; verify that reference parsing stays outside the engine-neutral Mesh package.

priorAttempts.decision: historical approval under superseded one-sided count rule
rejected only on architecture confidence 0.77 < 0.8; approval probability 0.87, DoD 0.90, artist topology 0.89

inScope: Use artist counts and normalized cross-section profile from the matching original Spine 4.0.64 attachment to guide static contour and interior control density.
Enforce +/-20% on beard and house separately before SDK load; compare outer/inner distributions and visual topology; preserve separate <=2% alpha errors and Tail baseline.
Explicitly verify the package boundary behind the prior Jev architecture concern.
outOfScope: Bone/weight/deform generation, head animation quality, full Spine JSON import into Mesh, schema changes, production-art approval, private source files in Git

architectureEvidence.privateReferenceParsingLocation: tools/mesh-reference-check.mjs (developer tool, not a runtime package)
architectureEvidence.engineInput: Plain numeric MeshGenerationOptions.referenceTopology: total vertices, hull vertices and optional dimensionless {position,widthFraction} bands. It contains no Spine JSON object, bone, skin, slot, attachment or artist XY coordinates. The Mesh engine rebuilds coordinates from the current alpha raster. A generic caller can pass equivalent numeric metadata without Spine.
architectureEvidence.automatedCheck: tests/package-boundaries.test.ts checks Mesh package dependencies, TypeScript project references and absence of Spine/asset/core/Jev imports in the reference-aware mesh generator; this test passes.
architectureEvidence.documentation: ARCHITECTURE.md describes precisely how dev-only Spine reference parsing hands numeric data into engine-neutral Mesh.

implementationSummary: Original matching UV/hull/triangle arrays are parsed only by a developer-side tool. The tool validates exact image dimensions and derives artist counts and normalized interior structural bands. Mesh receives these numeric guides, uses deterministic raster contour simplification with cumulative +/-2% coverage guards, and computes interior control coordinates from current opaque cross-sections. No artist XY/edges are copied. Existing schema and package dependency direction stay unchanged. Unknown assets without a reference use the earlier sparse starter path and remain explicitly flagged for review. Jev always receives a local precheck result first.

checks.name: Package boundaries and full verification
checks.evidence: npm run verify passes Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript build/typecheck and 49 tests in 7 files including the new architecture test. packages/mesh/package.json has only schemas, TypeBox and Earcut dependencies; packages/mesh/tsconfig.json references only schemas; source has zero Spine, asset, core or Jev imports. No schemas or runtime package manifests were changed. git diff --check passes.

checks.name: Matched artist count hard rule
checks.evidence: Beard 24 artist and 24 generated: 24 hull, zero interior, 22 triangles each. House 25 artist and 25 generated: 19 hull, six interior, 29 triangles each. Signed deviations are 0%, inside each required +/-20% interval. The previous 11/25 house fails the local rule before the Jev SDK loads; missing references block. Tests exercise interval boundaries and the actual review runner.

checks.name: Reference topology proximity
checks.evidence: The first repaired house mesh placed its six interior points at generic equal-height, one-third/two-thirds cross sections, with independent symmetric mean nearest interior distance 43.9309 pixels to original artist points. After deriving dimensionless reference bands, the same metric is 2.8183 pixels; hull mean nearest is 5.3380 pixels. Beard boundary mean nearest is 2.8238 pixels, and its hull-only distribution matches artist. Exact artist/old/new coordinate overlays were inspected. Beard still has four narrow triangles vs artist zero; house has five vs artist twelve. This is static topology evidence, not identical connectivity or animated approval.

checks.name: Coverage and repeatability
checks.evidence: Independent pixel-center test on original PNGs after the same explicit 0.5% cleanup: beard misses/adds 16/16 of 882 corrected foreground (1.8141% each); house 112/423 of 51,606 (0.2170%/0.8197%). Both pass independent MeshSpec validation. The previously approved Tail remains 24 vertices/27 triangles and misses/adds 1297/306 of 81,641; all three private cases generate byte-identically 100 times. Portable synthetic reference profile also repeats 100 times.

knownLimitations: An artist reference file is needed to obtain profile metadata. New art without one remains a review-required starter mesh.
Vertex-location proximity does not prove matching triangle edges or animation deformation. Beard retains four sub-10-degree triangles.
Head with Idle deform remains unresolved; Rig, Weight and animation remain later Gates.
